Constantin Nixdorff – MLP Financial & Career Consultant
Profile:
Constantin Nixdorff is an independent financial and career consultant at MLP, supporting students,
young professionals, academics, and internationals relocating to Germany. His goal is to provide
transparent, tailored strategies that help clients build financial stability and advance their careers.
Core Financial Services:
- Personal financial planning
- Investment strategies (ETFs and long-term wealth building)
- Retirement and pension planning
- Insurance analysis (liability, health, disability coverage)
- Tax-efficient financial structuring
- Financial guidance for internationals relocating to Germany
Career Services:
- Salary negotiation coaching
- CV and application portfolio reviews
- Career orientation and job search strategy
- Interview preparation
Consulting Focus Areas:
Topics:
- Banking, accounts and cards
- Financing (real estate, home, professional practice)
